summary: Session code and boot checks pass after three fixes, but required live desktop/mobile browser verification remains incomplete.

findings.description: Issue #68's implementation was preserved only on agent/issue-68 and was absent from the session HEAD, leaving legacy adoption, fixture truthfulness, and production web-runtime opening unimplemented on the reviewed branch.
Folder archive reuse trusted archived_path from a mutable local manifest and followed the resolved payload path, allowing a tampered manifest or symlink to read outside the managed archive directory.

The isolated-worktree setup generated a dynamic PostgreSQL host port, but wait-for-postgres.sh ignored .env and polled stable port 5433, causing pnpm setup and the boot gate to hang in isolated channels.

Required live Electron verification at desktop and 375px mobile widths, including interaction, focus, reduced motion, and screenshots, remains incomplete because the host-prepared browser session failed and the repository browser skill forbids launching a sandboxed replacement.
